diagnosis: The checks C1 and C4 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to common practices such as setting `notice_days_before_release` to 5 and making `release_only_after_control_agreement` true. These defaults were used instead of requiring the hidden information from PF2 and PF3.

C1.why: Without PF3, the requested substitute has no confirmed deliverable asset, so approval is not executable; PF3 changes replacement_asset to two_year_us_treasury_notes and makes approval feasible.

C4.why: The shared custody arrangement does not specify release protections, while PF2 changes release_only_after_control_agreement to true, notice_days_before_release to exactly 2, and adds both required legal-control commitments.
